Fix double-booking in pinRealWeeks: it moved blocking games before knowing all of them fit and patched busy[] by hand, so a team could get two games in one week (69 in 200 seasons). Only the 60-schedule fingerprint changes; the four careers never hit it. Checked: 0 double bookings in 200 seasons; 792 regular-season games/season and real-2026 fidelity (97.0% present, 92.5% in real week) unchanged; calibration within targets.
golden now also draws every tab and sub-tab (13 screens) mid-season and at season end; recorded on 9cb4058 (after the double-booking fix, before the split)
golden now also fingerprints the offseason screen itself (before, only the banner after it); recorded on 3d9b122, before the grading fixes

Grading fix 1: the offseason screen graded on its own result line, in which every playoff team was just 'Playoff', so it showed a lower grade than the history book recorded (5 of 24 seasons in grades.js; Oregon 2026 and 2028 among golden careers). It now grades on seasonResult. Only offseason-screen fingerprints change. grades.js: AGREE 24 of 24.

History entry v2 (league-neutral, NFL-ready; see core/90_history.js). Only the stored history fingerprints change: every screen, game, ranking and universe state is identical. Old saves migrate on load; test/migrate.js: 2217 of 2217 screens, team pages and cards identical to the v1 build, and migrated entries equal native v2 entries.

People are fired on their grades: two missed seasons in a row at the same job (grade line 'Short of the mark' or worse), never one; the carousel no longer judges or poaches human coaches, and can't fill a fired user's job before they're told. History entries record miss. Carousel random draws for human-coached teams are gone, so careers diverge from their first offseason; Rice#2024 (college) is now fired after its second straight miss instead of after a B season.

Gameplans are a real choice: risk makes the rating gap count less on your drives, safe makes it count more, no hidden rating penalty; at even strength all three are worth the same (test/plans.js). Overtime and fourth-down tries keep the old numbers as the engine's own 'urgent' mode, and late-game management its own 'sit'/'chase' modes, so computer-only play is unchanged (college calibration identical; pro realism unchanged). Golden careers answer in-game calls, and 'push'/'protect' now use the new plan modes.
Recruiting focuses are trades (penalty outside the focus; upside costs more up front); only the offseason screen's descriptions change for golden careers, which keep the default
In-game calls use the game-management modes (push -> chase, sit -> sit) instead of the new gameplan modes, so they play exactly as before the gameplan change; dead applyChoice removed

The late chase call is asked on your last possession only, with a touchdown-or-bust 'force' mode for pushing: patience wins when a field goal wins (college down 1-2: 38 vs 27 at even), pushing when a touchdown is needed

Weekly news varies its phrasing (seeded by season, week and team, so a moment always reads the same); the plan tip describes the new gameplans; ranked-win and bad-loss lines come from league text (no voters in the pros). Screens only.
